title.en: Is the point on the line?

after.zh: 一个点在线上，当且仅当 q·l′ = qᵀF p = 0：这就是对极约束。它不告诉你配的是哪个点，只排除不可能的点，所以常用来筛掉错配。
after.en: A point lies on the line exactly when q·l′ = qᵀF p = 0: this is the epipolar constraint. It does not say which point is the match, only rules out impossible ones, so it is often used to throw out wrong matches.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-7-7"></part-ref>读 F 的三列和点 (x, y)，输出极线 F·p。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-7-7"></part-ref> in the tray reads the three columns of F and a point (x, y), and outputs the epipolar line F·p.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：判断右图的点 q 能不能和左图的点 p 对应。
t.en: Your task in this level: decide whether the right point q can correspond to the left point p.

brief.zh: 右图的点 q 能和左图的点 p 对应吗？q 落在 p 的极线上（|q·l′| < 0.05）输出 1，否则输出 0。
brief.en: Can the right point q correspond to the left point p? Output 1 if q lies on p's epipolar line (|q·l′| < 0.05), otherwise 0.

hint.zh: 点乘就是逐个相乘再加起来；三个数的平均乘 3 就是它们的和。
hint.en: A dot product multiplies number by number and adds up; the average of three numbers times 3 is their sum.

solution: l = own-7-7(c1, c2, c3, px, py)
